overall_notes: The paper focuses on indicative summarization of long discussions using hierarchical clustering and LLM-based labeling. Evaluation includes both automatic metrics (BERTScore, ROUGE, Accuracy) and human evaluation (ranking studies and user study with DISCUSSION EXPLORER interface).
